header.service: DEMO — UC San Diego Athletics Fan & Revenue Lifecycle
header.scope: First contact with Triton athletics → Renewal, lapse, or a first Triton Athletic Fund gift
header.lead: A. Practice Lead, Director of AI Strategy

personDoes.value: Encounters a game through a friend, a social post, or the schedule page.

frontstage.value: Marketing runs paid and organic promotion and sends campaign email to hand-built segments.

backstage.value: Marketing exports last season's purchase history from the ticketing platform, re-uploads it to the email platform, and builds segments by hand — last season's buyers, single-game buyers, students, lapsed.

systems.value: Email & campaign platform; ticketing platform (as an exported file); web, social, and streaming.

personDoes.value: Buys on mobile; an account and a barcode are created.

frontstage.value: Ticketing platform handles the sale and issues the ticket to the wallet app; confirmation email sent.

backstage.value: Ticket operations holds the seat inventory and the price tier set before the season; the account record stays inside the ticketing platform.

personDoes.value: Transfers a ticket to a guest, arrives, scans in, spends at concessions.

frontstage.value: Gate staff scan tickets; event operations run the venue; concessions and merchandise operate at the till.

backstage.value: The manifest is pushed to the scanners the morning of the game; scans are recorded against barcodes; the comp list is assembled in a spreadsheet the week of the game and excluded from the marketing audience by hand.

systems.value: Gate scanning; ticketing platform; point-of-sale; comp-list spreadsheet.

personDoes.value: Receives a thank-you and a next-game offer at the buying account.

frontstage.value: Marketing sends post-event follow-up and retargeted offers on a one-to-two-week cadence.

backstage.value: Scan data returns as a gate count rather than as identified accounts, so campaign response cannot be tied to attendance; follow-up is addressed to the account of record.

systems.value: Email & campaign platform; ticketing platform (attendance counts only).

personDoes.value: Renews season tickets, receives a Fund letter days later, and makes a first gift.

frontstage.value: Ticket operations issue renewal invoices; the Triton Athletic Fund mails the annual solicitation; central Advancement issues the receipt.

backstage.value: Ticket operations email the season-ticket holder file to the Fund roughly monthly; the Fund director decides who is approached and at what amount; clearance against central prospect assignment is requested case by case, often after the letter has gone; gifts route to central Advancement for batch processing and receipting.

systems.value: Ticketing platform; Athletics donor records; central Advancement CRM; email.

personDoes.value: Stops buying without notice; may or may not receive a win-back offer.

frontstage.value: A post-season win-back email, when it runs.

backstage.value: Marketing builds a lapsed list from an export after the season and works it manually in spreadsheet order, as far as available student-worker time allows.

systems.value: Email & campaign platform; lapsed-buyer spreadsheet; ticketing platform (as an exported file).

handoffs.whatMoves: Purchase history, as a campaign audience list
handoffs.how: Manual export from the ticketing platform, re-uploaded to the email platform; promo codes configured by hand
handoffs.whatBreaks: The file is already about a week old when the campaign sends, so people who have already bought are asked to buy again (FR-02).

handoffs.how: Manifest pushed to the scanning devices on the morning of the game
handoffs.whatBreaks: A transferred ticket still scans under the buyer's barcode, so the person at the gate is not the person of record (FR-01).

handoffs.how: Returned as a gate count, not as identified accounts
handoffs.whatBreaks: Nobody can answer whether the people who were emailed actually came, so follow-up is aimed at the buying account (FR-03, FR-04).

handoffs.how: Pulled by hand and emailed, roughly monthly, sometimes less often
handoffs.whatBreaks: The Fund solicits from a picture weeks out of date; recent joiners and recent lapses are both missed (FR-05).

handoffs.whatMoves: The gift, for processing and receipting
handoffs.how: Batch cycle through central gift processing
handoffs.whatBreaks: Acknowledgment lags the gift by weeks, and the Fund cannot produce a receipt when the donor calls (FR-07).

handoffs.how: Requested by email, case by case; no shared identifier between the two donor systems
handoffs.whatBreaks: Clearance is often requested after the letter has gone out, so an assigned prospect can be solicited without either side knowing (FR-06).

decisions.decision: Which price tier a game is set at
decisions.whoDecides: Assistant AD, Ticket & Event Operations, with the lifecycle owner's sign-off
decisions.decidesOn: Opponent draw, day of week, historical sell-through, and the conference slate
decisions.basis: A pre-season tier recommendation approved by the Senior Associate AD; marquee games adjusted in-season
decisions.failurePath: Tier set too high and the game does not sell, or too low and revenue is left behind

decisions.decision: Which audience segment receives which offer, and when
decisions.decidesOn: Hand-built segments from an exported purchase file: last season's buyers, single-game buyers, students, lapsed
decisions.basis: Prior-season performance and the marketer's read; no automated scoring in use
decisions.failurePath: Offers sent to people who have already bought, or landing in the same week as a giving ask

decisions.decision: Whether a lapsed buyer is worked in the win-back campaign
decisions.decidesOn: Last purchase date and available staff time
decisions.basis: A spreadsheet built after the season and worked in order until time runs out
decisions.failurePath: Lapsed buyers go unworked because capacity ran out, not because they were ruled out

decisions.decision: Which season-ticket holders are approached for a first Triton Athletic Fund gift, and at what amount
decisions.decidesOn: Tenure in seats, seat location, and attendance at events beyond basketball
decisions.basis: The Fund director's judgment against the monthly season-ticket file; no propensity model in use, and the unit is explicit that it wants care taken before one is introduced
decisions.failurePath: Solicitation runs off a stale file and the ask amount rests on partial history

decisions.decision: Who owns the relationship with a donor who gives to both Athletics and a campus unit
decisions.whoDecides: Central Advancement prospect management, with the Triton Athletic Fund
decisions.decidesOn: Existing prospect assignment in the central CRM
decisions.basis: Assignment is decided centrally, and a unit should request clearance before soliciting an assigned prospect
decisions.failurePath: Clearance is requested after the letter has gone out, or two officers cultivate the same household in the same year

decisions.decision: Whether a complimentary-ticket recipient enters the marketing audience
decisions.decidesOn: How the comp was issued — staff, recruit, or community group
decisions.basis: Comps are excluded from the marketing audience by rule
decisions.failurePath: The comp list is built in a spreadsheet the week of the game, so exclusions are applied by hand and can be missed

systems.name: Ticketing & digital wallet platform (vendor — illustrative)
systems.usedFor: Sales, seat inventory, season-ticket accounts, barcode issue and transfer
systems.dataHeld: Purchase history, account records, seat locations, barcodes
systems.connectsTo: Gate scanning; point-of-sale. Nothing automated to the email platform or to either donor system — those files move by hand.

systems.name: Email & campaign platform (vendor — illustrative)
systems.usedFor: Audience segmentation, campaign send, offer delivery
systems.dataHeld: Contact records, segment membership, send and open history
systems.connectsTo: Manual imports from the ticketing platform; sign-up forms on the web. No link to donor records.

systems.name: Gate scanning
systems.connectsTo: Ticketing platform — counts only, not identified accounts.

systems.name: Athletics donor records (Triton Athletic Fund)
systems.usedFor: Fund solicitation lists, ask history, Fund giving levels
systems.dataHeld: Donor names, giving history to Athletics, solicitation notes
systems.connectsTo: Monthly file from the ticketing platform; central Advancement CRM by name-and-address matching.

systems.name: Central Advancement CRM
systems.usedFor: System of record for donors, prospect assignment, gift processing and receipting
systems.dataHeld: Donor records, prospect assignments, gift and receipt history
systems.connectsTo: Athletics donor records by manual matching. No visibility into ticket purchase at all.

systems.name: Point-of-sale (concessions and merchandise)
systems.dataHeld: Transaction records, not tied to accounts
systems.connectsTo: Nothing else in this map — the till is anonymous.

systems.name: Web, social, and streaming
systems.dataHeld: Traffic and engagement metrics, no identity
systems.connectsTo: Email platform, via sign-up forms only.

breakingPoints.what: The same person exists as a ticket account, an email contact, a barcode, and two donor records, with no shared key between them
Attendance returns as a gate count, so 'did they come back' cannot be answered account by account
The Fund solicits from a monthly file and asks clearance after the letter has gone
Renewal and the giving ask arrive in the same window from two teams that do not share a calendar
